data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-R-F', which refers to 'gardens' or 'paradise'. In Islamic context, Aaraf can symbolize the heavenly abode of peace and tranquility, where one's spiritual and emotional needs are fulfilled. The name Aaraf carries the meaning “Gardens of paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaraf usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Hence, the name Aaraf can be seen as a reminder of the heavenly rewards that await the believers in the hereafter.
